scenes.text: Sea otters have the densest fur of any animal on Earth.
Up to one million hairs grow on a single square inch of their skin.
That's up to ten times more hair than on an entire human head.
Unlike seals and whales, sea otters have no blubber to keep them warm.
Their thick fur and a fast metabolism keep them warm in cold ocean water.
To fuel that, they eat about a quarter of their body weight every day.
How much would you have to eat to keep up?

title: This animal has a million hairs per square inch 🦦
caption: Sea otters have 500,000 to 1,000,000 hairs per square inch, the densest fur of any animal. With no blubber, that fur (and eating ~25% of their body weight a day) keeps them warm. 🦦
